title: 第23章 看上人家了第24章 差点露馅
slug: 赵老驴和杏花村的女人们
content_zh:
“我说你不行，你非要逞能……还是我来帮你吧，反正帮你浇地没什么大不了的，鸡毛蒜皮的小事而已。”
赵大柱说着就抓起自己的铁锹，踏入王彩霞的农田。
只见他一铁锹下去就翻起了一大块泥巴，啪的一声就堵住水口，浑浊的水流一眨眼的功夫就改道流向旁边那条土沟。
这简单粗暴干净利落的动作，与刚才的王彩霞相比，简直就是一个天上一个地上。
王彩霞现在也不好意思再说什么了，羞答答的站在路边，抿着嘴看赵大柱帮自己浇地。
过了好长时间，王彩霞才终于逐渐放松下来，说道：“这种粗活累活果然还是得你们男人干，你这个老头都比我这个妇道人家强。”
“你这不是废话嘛，我虽然老了，可我力气大的很，你跟我当然不能比。”赵大柱笑呵呵的说道。
忽然，一个四十多岁的村妇提着菜篮子从旁边经过。
看到赵大柱站在王彩霞的农田里浇地，而且王彩霞也在这里，她立即就明白这是怎么回事了。
于是她笑吟吟的说道：“哟，赵老驴你帮彩霞妹子浇地啊？”
“她干不了这活儿，我帮帮她。”赵大柱说道。
这个村妇嗤笑一声，又说道：“你这么好心，那我昨天浇地的时候你怎么不来帮帮我？”
“你又不是没男人，找你男人帮你去。”赵大柱没好气的说道。
村妇接着说道：“还装啥呢，我看你就是相中彩霞这个寡妇了，所以才赶着趟儿给人家帮忙。”
这个村妇此话一出，赵大柱倒是没太大反应，可王彩霞羞的都快不敢抬头看人了。
“闭上你的臭嘴行不行？”赵大柱瞪着眼睛说道。
“我开个玩笑，你这么激动干嘛，难道被我说中了？不过话说回来，彩霞妹子是寡妇，赵老驴你又没个老伴儿，你俩要是凑一起还真挺般配，就是你年纪大了许多……”这个村妇喋喋不休的说道。
赵大柱扬起铁锹作势欲打，这个村妇才终于笑着跑开。
而王彩霞已经忍不了这尴尬的滋味了。
她搓搓手就抓起铁锹说道：“要不还是算了吧，你别帮我了，我自己来，不然村里人会说闲话的。”

“她只是开个玩笑而已，你别往心里去，再说了我都给你帮忙了，怎么能半途而废？”赵大柱坚持道。
王彩霞还想再说什么，却又不好意思说，于是一脸欲言又止的表情。
赵大柱想了想就说道：“算了，你别在这里站着了，赶紧回家去吧。我给你浇完了，再给我的农田浇水，你不用担心。”
“你在这儿给我帮忙，我咋好意思走？”王彩霞扭扭捏捏的说道。
“有啥不好意思的，叫你走你就走，你在这儿看着我，我反倒不自在！”赵大柱加重语气说道。
王彩霞实在没办法，只好拿着铁锹，一步三回头的离开了。
王彩霞走了以后，赵大柱浇地的速度就更快了，不到半个小时他就把王彩霞家的一亩多地全部浇了一遍，然后又给自己的农田浇水。
话说速生灵散的效果是真的很不错，一晚上没过来看，地里的圣女果藤蔓又长高了一大截。
按照这个速度判断，也许只需要一个月，圣女果就可以收获了！
赵大柱干劲十足，好像浑身都有使不完的力气。
content_en:
"I said you can't do it. If you insist on showing off... let me help you. Anyway, it's not a big deal to help you water the ground. It's just a trivial matter."
As Zhao Dazhu spoke, he grabbed his shovel and stepped into Wang Caixia's farmland.
I saw that he turned up a large piece of mud with a shovel, and blocked the water outlet with a bang. In the blink of an eye, the turbid water was diverted to the ditch next to it.
Compared with Wang Caixia just now, this simple, rough and clean movement is like heaven and earth.
Wang Caixia was too embarrassed to say anything now. She stood shyly on the roadside, pursed her lips and watched Zhao Dazhu help her water the ground.
After a long time, Wang Caixia finally relaxed and said: "Sure enough, you men still have to do this kind of rough and tiring work. You, an old man, are better than me, a woman."
"Aren't you talking nonsense? Although I am old, I am very strong. Of course you can't compare with me." Zhao Dazhu said with a smile.
Suddenly, a village woman in her forties passed by carrying a vegetable basket.
Seeing Zhao Dazhu standing in Wang Caixia's farmland watering the ground, and Wang Caixia was also here, she immediately understood what was going on.
So she said with a smile: "Hey, Mr. Zhao, can you help Miss Caixia water the ground?"
"She can't do this job, let me help her." Zhao Dazhu said.
The village woman sneered and said, "You are so kind, then why didn't you come and help me when I was watering the ground yesterday?"
"It's not like you don't have a man. Ask your man to help you." Zhao Dazhu said angrily.
The village woman continued: "Why are you pretending? I think you are the widow Xiangzhong Caixia, so you rushed to help others."
When the village woman said this, Zhao Dazhu didn't react much, but Wang Caixia was so shy that she almost didn't dare to look up at anyone.
"Can you shut up your stinky mouth?" Zhao Dazhu said with wide eyes.
"I'm just kidding, why are you so excited? Did I tell you the truth? But having said that, Miss Caixia is a widow, and you, Old Donkey Zhao, don't have a wife. If you two get together, you would be a good match, but you are much older..." the village woman chattered.
Zhao Dazhu raised the shovel as if to strike, but the village woman finally ran away with a smile.
And Wang Caixia couldn't bear the embarrassment anymore.
She rubbed her hands and grabbed the shovel and said, "Why don't you forget it? Don't help me. I'll do it myself, otherwise the villagers will gossip."
"She was just joking. Don't take it seriously. Besides, I've already helped you. How can I give up halfway?" Zhao Dazhu insisted.
Wang Caixia wanted to say something more, but was embarrassed to say it, so she looked like she was hesitant to speak.
Zhao Dazhu thought for a while and said: "Forget it, don't stand here anymore, go home quickly. I've finished watering you, and I will water my farmland again. You don't have to worry."
"You are here to help me, why should I leave?" Wang Caixia said coquettishly.
"What's the point of being embarrassed? Just leave if I ask you to leave. I feel uncomfortable with you looking at me here!" Zhao Dazhu said in a serious tone.
Wang Caixia really had no choice but to take the shovel and leave step by step.
After Wang Caixia left, Zhao Dazhu watered the land faster. In less than half an hour, he watered more than an acre of Wang Caixia's family's land, and then watered his own farmland.
It is said that the effect of Sushengling Powder is really good. I didn't come over to see it overnight, and the cherry tomato vines in the field grew a lot taller.
Judging at this speed, it may only take a month for the cherry tomatoes to be harvested!
Zhao Dazhu was full of energy, as if he had endless energy in his body.
